message: The other day, as I was cozying up on the couch with a cup of tea, the weather app on my phone decided to take an unexpected vacation. Just as the storm rolled in and the power flickered, I realized my backup flashlight was in the garage, and my phone was about to join it in the dark. Lesson learned: sometimes the tech we rely on can be less reliable than my old weathered radio. So now, I keep a few extra batteries and a trusty flashlight in the living room, just in case—because nothing says 'fun' like fumbling around in the dark. Do you have any favorite backup plans for stormy days?
